title: Chapter 198: Interception And Annihilation War At All Costs
content:
Chapter 198: Interception And Annihilation War At All Costs

"The flying dragons are so efficient!"

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the performance of the Zerg flying dragons.

The Zerg flying dragons did not stop, left the small town that had become a ruin, and flew directly to the next target city.

The next target city was very close, and could only be regarded as a micro-city, with only tens of thousands of troops stationed there.

The Zerg flying dragons continued to quickly annihilate the army of the Bugbears in minutes.

With the existence of the three-star host, no intelligent creatures in the target city and its surroundings could be spared, and all these enemies were annihilated to ensure that the news of the Zerg flying dragons' attack would not be transmitted to the top leaders of the Bugbears for the time being.

In this way, the Zerg flying dragons raided sixteen Bugbears' garrison cities of different sizes in a short period of two hours, and annihilated a total of about one million Bugbears' ordinary troops.

This was an unprecedentedly successful lightning raid. The Zerg dragon group's raid on the ordinary army of the Bugbear tribe was like a dimensionality reduction attack. The ordinary army of the Bugbear tribe had no power to fight back at all. They were all annihilated in a very short time.

The time of the Zerg dragon group was mainly consumed on the road.

Just like Naga said, for some reason, there are no strong armies of the two camps in this area, and it is even more impossible to send flying troops here, so the army in this area almost does not care about the problem of air defense.

Facing the air raid of the Zerg dragon group, the army of the Bugbear tribe had no way to deal with it.

Two hours later, the Zerg dragon group made such a big noise in the Bugbear tribe's sphere of influence that the Bugbear tribe finally noticed the abnormality.

The Zerg dragon group paused the attack. After two hours of high-intensity fighting, the ordinary Zerg dragons also needed to rest and recover.

The next target of the Zerg dragon group is a medium-sized city with a large number of garrisons, almost all of which are soldiers of the Bugbear tribe.

Compared with other armies, this is an elite force. Now that they are alert, it will take a lot of time for the Zerg dragon group to attack and annihilate this army.

Therefore, Wu Qing asked the dragon group to slow down and sent a small number of dragons to explore the depths of the Bugbear tribe's sphere of influence, and continue to look for targets that are easy to annihilate quickly.

Zerg dragons fly fast, and as long as they fly higher, they will not encounter any danger.

Zerg dragons conduct large-scale detection, which is much more efficient than Zerg puppies. This is a huge advantage of air units.

Wu Qing has been using Zerg puppies for reconnaissance, mainly for the actual control and real-time monitoring of the sphere of influence. A Zerg puppy is insignificant. As long as it lurks in some key locations, it can monitor a large area around it.

When there is danger, they can burrow into the ground and lurk. When they need to act, they can gather together to fight, which is very convenient.

The most important thing is that they are numerous, consume few resources, and can be deployed and sacrificed at will.

The high-altitude reconnaissance range of the Zerg dragons is very wide. They only need to find the city and fly over to take a look at the situation. This reconnaissance method is very simple and suitable for them.

If it is a detailed reconnaissance, a large amount of various information needs to be collected, then a more professional host must be dispatched.

The reconnaissance of the Zerg host will make all the enemy's hiding and deception measures invalid, and all kinds of details can be clearly explored. They are generally controlled by the queen herself, and collect some specific information according to the task.

Not long after, the Zerg dragons discovered some new cities where the army of the bugbears gathered. As long as those cities that are easy to annihilate quickly are found, the Zerg dragon group will immediately go out and attack these cities first.

The main task of the Zerg dragon group today is to eliminate the living forces of the bugbear army in large numbers and obtain as many system resources as possible.

Of course, you have to find soft persimmons to squeeze, eat the easy and delicious ones first, and then gnaw on those hard bones that are more difficult to chew.

Another two hours passed. Based on the latest intelligence, the Zerg dragons moved around in the Bugbears' sphere of influence and turned all the easily captured Bugbears' garrison cities into ruins.

Even though many cities were in a state of war readiness, they still couldn't do anything about the Zerg dragons. The various temporary air defense measures of the Bugbears' army did not cause any damage to the Zerg dragons, but only increased the time consumed by the Zerg dragons.

The long-range troops in each city posed little threat to the Zerg dragons. As long as the three-star hosts in the Zerg dragons detected the source of the threat, they would command the one-star dragons to concentrate their fire to eliminate it, making these threats ineffective.

With more than four hours of reaction time, the Bugbears finally realized that there was a powerful army from the air sweeping their assembled army!

The air defense capability of the bear goblins in this area is very weak. They had never considered this problem before. Now faced with this unexpected situation, the only thing they can do is to mobilize all the surviving troops and gather them to the city where the green troops of the bear goblins are stationed.

All kinds of prepared logistical materials are also transported there, and the general assembly place of the bear goblin army is temporarily rebuilt there.

The sphere of influence of the bear goblins was quickly mobilized, and all the surviving garrison cities, including the small number of troops that were not originally in the garrison cities, were urgently dispatched to gather at the general assembly place.

The current situation is critical. The bear goblins have mobilized all the troops they can mobilize, preparing to concentrate their combat power to overcome this crisis.

The cities responsible for logistics and supply have shipped a large number of supplies. As long as the supplies can reach the general assembly point before dark, they will all be shipped and urgently transported to the general assembly point.

Wu Qing discovered through the reconnaissance flying dragon that the bear goblins' troops and personnel and supplies were everywhere. If the Zerg flying dragon group was allowed to fight one by one, it would definitely be unrealistic. There are too many targets and they are too scattered.

Even if the enemies stand still, the Zerg flying dragon group will fly over to fight one by one, and they will not be able to finish fighting today.

But we can't let so many scattered bear goblin troops gather together. The total number of these troops is probably more than two million.

In addition, the unknown strong army of the Green Department of the Goblin Clan can serve as the core of this army, and its overall combat power is not as simple as one plus one.

If the Zerg wants to defeat such an army, it must pay a huge price, and Wu Qing does not want to see such a situation.

So he must do his best to intercept these gathering armies and prevent this army from appearing in the strongest posture.

As for the transported supplies, let them go for the time being. As long as the army is gone, no matter how many supplies there are, it will be useless.

Wu Qing ordered the Zerg flying dragon group to first clear the army of the Bear Goblin Clan closest to the city where the Green Department of the Goblin Clan is stationed, and prevent these armies from joining the Green Department of the Goblin Clan.

Wu Qing used the resources that he had just obtained and had not yet warmed up to hatch 20,000 Zerg flying dragons and 5,000 explosive mosquitoes, upgraded a three-star host again, and ordered them to quickly fly to the sphere of influence of the Bear Goblin Clan and join the Zerg flying dragon group that was fighting.

Not long after, the Zerg dragon group that was annihilating the army of the Bugbear tribe below joined the newly hatched 20,000 dragons.

Wu Qing divided 50,000 dragons, two three-star hosts, five queens and ten three-star explosive mosquitoes into two teams. With the city where the Bugbear tribe's green army was stationed as the center, they circled around to annihilate the Bugbear tribe's army.

The 5,000 explosive mosquitoes were divided into teams of 100 each, dispersed, patrolled and stood by at high altitudes to fill the gaps in the interception of the two Zerg dragon groups.

As long as the Queen of the Zerg predicts that there are too many enemies coming and the two dragon groups cannot intercept them in time, the Zerg explosive mosquitoes will rush up and bomb them once, interfering with the enemy's marching speed.

The advantage of the Zerg flying army is too obvious. The movements of the Bugbear tribe's army are all under the control of the Queen of the Zerg. The Queen of the Zerg commands two flexible dragon groups and dozens of explosive mosquito teams to work closely and coordinate operations, and no enemy army breaks through the interception.

The Zerg Explosive Swarm played an extremely important role at this time. The army of the Bugbear tribe had no ability to counterattack the Zerg dragon swarm in the air when they were marching.

When the army of the Bugbear tribe with more troops was intercepted by the Zerg dragon swarm, they chose to split into small groups and break through in a dispersed manner, which increased the difficulty of clearing the Zerg dragon swarm and wasted a lot of time.

At this time, the Zerg Explosive Swarm had to be used for emergency response. They could intercept other enemy troops on their way, and they could also help the dragon swarm to chase and kill scattered enemy teams.

If they were blown up by the Zerg Explosive Swarm, they would be injured if not dead. If they were injured and could not run, the Zerg could ignore them first.

In the face of this situation, the two Zerg dragon swarms should not be split up. They are the main force to annihilate the enemy. Reducing their troops will seriously affect the efficiency of annihilating the enemy.

Now the Zerg has three battlefields: the Bugbear tribe's sphere of influence, the underground world, and the Naga tribe's territory. When fighting at the same time, the system resources increase very quickly.

Wu Qing hardened his heart and hatched another 10,000 flying dragons, divided into ten teams of 1,000 flying dragons to assist in clearing the remaining enemies.

The total number of Zerg flying dragons reached 60,000, plus more than 3,000 of them that had been upgraded to a star level. This was a huge consumption of Qi resources!

With Wu Qing's resource investment at all costs, the Zerg successfully intercepted the army of the Bugbears outside their general assembly point, preventing them from joining the most core army of the Bugbears Green Department.

The Bugbears saw that they could not break through the interception of the Zerg flying dragon group for a long time, and those Bugbears Green Department Army that had been sitting still finally took action.
